 LAUGFS Gas increases 12.5kg LPG cylinder price by Rs. 1,775
 14 Nov 2026 | BY Staff Writer
 LAUGFS Gas PLC has increased the price of its 12.5kg domestic LPG cylinder by Rs. 1,775, raising it from Rs. 4,965 to Rs. 6,740 with effect from midnight on 13 November.
 The price of its 5kg cylinder has also increased by Rs. 732, from Rs. 1,988 to Rs. 2,720.
 The company attributed the price revision to rising international LPG procurement costs, which have increased the cost of securing shipments to Sri Lanka.
 LAUGFS Gas stated that it would make every effort to maintain a continuous supply of refills through its dealer network. Customers can contact the company’s hotline on 1345 for information on refill availability and district-wise prices.
